a.xlink:title: Notifies controls when terrain availability changes after source replacement.
Sets the immutable terrain snapshot uploaded on the next paint pass.
Notifies tests and controls when terrain preparation changes readiness.
Positions and scales the stable terrain anchor relative to the current aircraft.
Reports whether the model mesh has no renderable geometry.
Returns either a fully validated immutable mesh or a user-facing failure message.
Shows DTED terrain; no land-colored fallback is drawn while a patch is loading.
Reports whether reading produced a validated model mesh.
Returns whether an immutable terrain patch is ready for GPU upload.
Returns vector-classified DTED/sea-level height at a current Plane X/Z coordinate.
Samples and triangulates one request, returning null when local terrain is absent.
Reports whether parsing produced a valid mesh.
